user.title: Telegram Menu
user.description: Configure the Telegram notification target, chat ID and menus.

data_description.notify_entity: The existing notify.telegram_bot_* entity used by your Telegram integration.
data_description.chat_id: Telegram chat ID that should receive the keyboard.
data_description.menus: Define menus and rows as JSON. Use keyboard_type 'reply' for normal Telegram commands or 'inline' for separate button labels and callback commands.

error.invalid_menus: The menu JSON is invalid. keyboard_type must be 'reply' or 'inline', and commands must start with /.
